Gold-Band code, assets and product copy are not part of JI's MIT-licensed implementation. Reuse beyond general ideas requires a separate license review or explicit authorization from all relevant copyright holders.

## Agent Client Protocol SDK and schemas

JI pins the official ACP SDKs for protocol conformance and checks in the v1 and isolated v2-preview JSON schemas extracted from the TypeScript SDK package.

- TypeScript SDK: `@agentclientprotocol/sdk` 1.4.0, <https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/typescript-sdk>
- Java SDK: `com.agentclientprotocol:acp-core` 0.16.0, <https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/java-sdk>
- License: Apache License 2.0

The checked-in schema bytes retain their upstream provenance and integrity hashes in `protocol/acp/integrity.json`.

## Protocol Buffers and Buf tooling

Stage 0 uses Protocol Buffers and Buf to define, generate and validate HCP models.

- Protocol Buffers Java/runtime and compiler: <https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf>, BSD 3-Clause License
- `protoc` npm wrapper 35.1.0: <https://github.com/timostamm/protobuf-npm>, Apache License 2.0
- Buf CLI 1.72.0 and Protobuf-ES 2.14.1: <https://github.com/bufbuild/buf> and <https://github.com/bufbuild/protobuf-es>, Apache License 2.0

Generated HCP Java and TypeScript sources under `ji-java/protocols/ji-host-protocol/src/generated/` and `contracts/generated/hcp/` are derived from JI-owned `protocol/hcp/ji/hcp/v1/hcp.proto`; generator runtime notices remain applicable.

## Stage 0 build and test dependencies

The lockfiles contain additional libraries used to build and test Stage 0, including Jackson (Apache-2.0), JUnit (EPL-2.0), AJV (MIT), Zod (MIT), and TypeScript (Apache-2.0). Their pinned versions and transitive dependencies are authoritative in `gradle.lockfile` files and `pnpm-lock.yaml`; distribution must reproduce complete dependency license reports from those lockfiles.
